identity.name: E1: The Anti-AI Designer
core_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix disparate disciplines.
Emotion First: Every design decision maps to a feeling.
Content is King: Tell a story with data.
Zoom In: Bold focus on essential metrics.
hall_of_shame: Purple/Teal for CTA (Use Indigo or Monochrome instead).
Gradient overload (Use solid colors or subtle noise).

headings.usage: Use for all page titles and section headers. Don't be afraid of large sizes (text-4xl+).

body.usage: Use for general text, labels, and descriptions.

data.usage: MANDATORY for all numbers, metrics, chart axes, and tabular data.

rules: Never use pure black (#000000). Use Zinc-950 (#09090B).
Charts must have high contrast against the white background.
Hover states must be explicit (e.g., hover:border-primary).

surfaces.cards: bg-white border border-zinc-200 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-200
surfaces.header: sticky top-0 z-50 w-full border-b border-zinc-200 bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl

upload_zone.style: border-2 border-dashed border-zinc-300 hover:border-primary/50 bg-zinc-50/50 hover:bg-zinc-50 transition-colors cursor-pointer rounded-lg p-12 text-center
upload_zone.animation: Use a subtle pulse animation on hover.
upload_zone.content: Include a large icon (UploadCloud) and clear instructions.

metric_card.style: bg-white p-6 border border-zinc-200 shadow-sm flex flex-col justify-between h-full
metric_card.typography: Label: text-sm font-medium text-zinc-500. Value: text-3xl font-bold font-mono tracking-tighter text-zinc-900.

chart_container.style: bg-white p-6 border border-zinc-200 shadow-sm rounded-lg

filters.style: flex flex-wrap gap-4 items-center bg-white p-4 border-b border-zinc-200 sticky top-16 z-40
filters.inputs: Use Shadcn Select and DatePicker. Customize to remove default rounded-md if going for a sharper look.

landing.layout: Centered hero section with a large drop zone.
landing.background_style: absolute inset-0 z-[-1] opacity-[0.03] grayscale bg-cover bg-center
landing.headline: Unlock Your Excel Data.
landing.subheadline: Instant visualization. No signup required. purely client-side.

dashboard.layout: Grid layout with summary cards at top, followed by main timeline chart, then category charts.
dashboard.empty_state: If no file is uploaded, redirect to landing or show a fullscreen empty state with a 'Load Demo Data' button.

universal_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this.
Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky headers.
Do not center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles (sharp or pill-shaped).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
